description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Conditions 3 (materials and external surfaces), 4 (landscape scheme), 8 (Drainage Strategy), 11 (Demolition and Construction Management Plan) and 12 (Biodiversity Gain Plan) of planning permission ref. 15756/APP/2024/3112, dated 16-01-2026 (Demolition of existing house and erection of a two storey, new build house consisting of 6no. bedrooms with a basement (Amended plans and description).)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The applicant has failed to provide sufficient details to discharge Condition 3 relating to external materials and finishes. In particular, the submission does not adequately specify the make, product/type, colour, or provide sufficiently detailed photographs/images of all proposed external materials and surfaces. As a result, the Local Planning Authority is unable to properly assess the visual appearance and design quality of the development, and whether it would preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the site and surrounding area. The requirements of the condition have therefore not been met, contrary to Policy DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

The applicant has failed to provide sufficient information to discharge Condition 4 relating to landscaping and associated site works. The submission does not adequately include the required details of soft landscaping, hard landscaping, other furniture, EVCP provision, landscape maintenance and implementation, including but not limited to planting plans, planting specifications, schedules of species and densities, refuse storage, cycle storage, boundary treatments, car parking arrangements, hard surfacing materials, external lighting, maintenance proposals and implementation details. In the absence of this information, the Local Planning Authority is unable to assess whether the proposed development would preserve and enhance the visual amenities of the locality or provide appropriate ancillary facilities. The requirements of the condition have therefore not been met, contrary to Policies DMHB 11, DMHB 12, DMHB 14, DMEI 1 and DMT 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

The applicant has failed to provide sufficient information to discharge Condition 8 relating to the drainage strategy for the development. The submission does not adequately provide the required details of the surface water and foul water drainage systems, including drainage layout plans, design calculations, pipe sizes, gradients, flow rates, attenuation measures and confirmation of compliance with greenfield runoff rates or maximum allowable discharge rates. Furthermore, insufficient information has been provided in relation to the proposed SuDS features, basement drainage arrangements, groundwater impacts, flood risk, and the specification, capacity and resilience of any proposed pumped drainage systems. The applicant has failed to provide sufficient information to discharge Condition 12 relating to Biodiversity Net Gain. Whilst the submitted Biodiversity Gain Plan indicates that the required 10% Biodiversity Net Gain cannot be achieved wholly on-site, no satisfactory evidence has been provided to demonstrate that the necessary off-site biodiversity units or statutory biodiversity credits have been secured. In particular, the submission fails to include confirmation of the purchase of off-site biodiversity credits or statutory credits, including receipts, proof of transaction or other verifiable evidence as required by the condition. In the absence of this information, the Local Planning Authority cannot be satisfied that the development would achieve the mandatory 10% Biodiversity Net Gain.
